supportBlocks.name: page-duo-p-1
supportBlocks.content: Duo does it all. Hucards & CD-ROM2. Duo is the ultimate all-in-one NEC video game system. Duo features an original-style cartridge slot, controller port and CD-ROM drive. This means it is compatible with all game formats: Hucards, TurboChips, and CD-ROM. Plus the original hardware and accessories.

supportBlocks.name: page-duo-p-2
supportBlocks.content: We're Preserving Video Game History with FPGA Hardware. Unlike traditional emulators that mimic console behavior through software, FPGA recreates the original hardware at the circuit level. It doesn't just simulate—it behaves exactly like the original system, delivering unparalleled accuracy, flawless timing, and true-to-life performance.

supportBlocks.name: page-duo-p-3
supportBlocks.content: Physical Compatibility FPGA: Can directly interface with original cartridges, discs and accessories because it recreates the console at the electrical + timing level. Everything behaves like original hardware.
